title: Vector and Static
author: Mirabel Amberdale
blurb: Bram Kavanagh, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
